free.title: Free products
free.pickTypeHint: Pick a type to view products.
free.quickSearchHint: Use the type (or name) as a keyword, e.g. “bread”, “pasta”. If “Gluten-free version” is checked, “gluten-free” is added automatically. Note that gluten-free searches may still return products containing gluten — always double-check.

fromInvoices.title: Add items from your invoices
fromInvoices.body: Use this button to automatically reuse gluten-free products already found in your invoices.
fromInvoices.hint: Click to open the list of invoice items.

factureModal.title: Choose items to reuse
factureModal.body: Select a product type, then add items you want to automatically include in your grocery list.
factureModal.hint: Click “Add to list” next to the items you want.

fromFree.title: Add custom products
fromFree.body: Create or reuse products you buy often, even if they don’t yet appear in your invoices.
fromFree.hint: Click to open your free products catalog.

freeModal.title: Add or reuse favorite products
freeModal.body: Create recurring products (bread, milk, snacks, etc.) or choose from those you already defined.
freeModal.hint: Select a type, then add a product.

freeType.title: Add a product not found in invoices
freeType.body: Choose a type (bread, milk, snacks, etc.), then add a product to your list.

save.title: Save this grocery list
save.body: Your list is ready. Save it so you can reuse it later.
save.hint: Click “Save” to return to the lists screen.
